items.title: Z.ai shares surge 8% after releasing new AI model running only on Chinese chips
items.content: Zhipu (Z.ai) shares jumped 8% after releasing an AI model that runs exclusively on Chinese-made chips, a milestone for China's semiconductor self-sufficiency drive. Rival MiniMax reported a nearly 300% surge in first-half revenue and shares gained about 3%.

items.title: Iran and Oman outline proposal for temporary shipping corridor through Strait of Hormuz
items.content: After weeks of negotiations over the strategic waterway - a key issue in stalled US-Iran discussions - Iran and Oman have outlined a proposal to establish a temporary shipping corridor through the Strait of Hormuz. The waterway remains the central sticking point of the 2026 Iran war.

items.title: 2026 Iran war: Iran asserts hegemonic control over Hormuz despite June MoU
items.content: Despite the June 2026 memorandum of understanding that sought to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end the Iran war, Iran is seeking to assert hegemonic control over the strait and eventually collect fees on ships passing through. Conflict had resumed in July as Iranian forces attacked commercial shipping deemed noncompliant.

items.title: July PCE shows inflation remained elevated amid high energy costs
items.content: Consumer prices were up 3.7% in July from a year earlier, according to the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, the PCE price index. The reading ran slightly hotter than the 3.6% consensus, driven in part by elevated energy costs linked to the Gulf conflict.

items.title: Fed's preferred inflation gauge shows core prices rose 3.3% annually in July
items.content: Headline PCE rose 0.1% month-over-month and 3.7% annually in July, 0.1 percentage point above the Dow Jones consensus. Core PCE posted gains of 0.2% monthly and 3.3% annually, in line with forecasts. Hotter headline keeps rate-hike worries alive.

items.title: Crude oil trades just below $83 as Gulf flows ease supply concerns
items.content: Crude pared earlier losses and traded just below $83 a barrel on Wednesday after two consecutive sessions of declines, as signs of increased flows from the Persian Gulf eased supply concerns. Traders are closely watching talks between Iran and Oman over a possible shipping corridor deal.

items.title: Nvidia beats Q2 FY27 estimates; guides Q3 revenue of $108B
items.content: Nvidia reported Q2 FY27 earnings on Aug 26 with EPS of $2.22, beating expectations of $2.09 by 6.2%. Management guided fiscal Q3 revenue of about $108 billion (plus or minus 2%), representing year-over-year growth of more than 89%.

items.title: US stocks close higher Thursday as strong Nvidia results lift tech
items.content: US indices closed higher on Thursday as strong results from Nvidia supported the technology sector. The S&P 500 rose 0.7%, the Nasdaq advanced 1.4% and the Dow added 105 points, recovering from the mid-week sell-off triggered by hot PCE inflation data.

items.title: Hang Seng Index little changed at 25,511 as tech comes under pressure
items.content: The Hang Seng Index closed little changed at 25,511 on Tuesday, tracking overnight weakness on Wall Street as technology shares came under pressure. Notable movers included Tencent (+1.0%), Wuxi Biologics (+2.1%), Xiaomi (+2.0%), Meituan (+2.3%) and Akeso (+7.4%).

items.title: Hang Seng rebounds 0.68% to 25,685; US indexes at latest levels
items.content: Hang Seng Index traded at 25,685.40, up 174.30 points (+0.68%), rebounding after the weak close. Dow Jones at 53,657.26 (+0.36%), Nasdaq Composite at 26,533.86 (+1.54%) following Nvidia's earnings beat.
